verdict.rationale: An official LiveKit CLI is documented in the livekit/livekit-cli repository. A hands-on probe confirmed it installs via `brew install livekit-cli` and runs (`lk version 2.18.6`) without any key. missing for 10: documentation of the CLI's commands (e.g., agent create/deploy/logs), any AI-native or agent-oriented CLI features such as machine-readable output, and independent community corroboration of CLI workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: `lk --version` printed `lk version 2.18.6` after a plain `brew install livekit-cli` — the official CLI runs keylessly.
